about: The airport is in the south of the Taimyr Peninsula, in the north of Krasnoyarsk Krai. Operator: Norilsk Airport LLC. Four airlines operate scheduled flights to ten Russian cities; passenger traffic in 2024 was 883,000 people.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus 33 runs between Norilsk (ADTs) bus station, Kayerkan (TBK) bus station and the terminal, journey time 1 h 10 min. Bus 110 to Dudinka leaves the airport daily at 09:00. The Dudinka bus stop is at the exit from the arrivals hall.

terminals.title: Terminal
terminals.text: One terminal building. Level 1: information desk, check-in counters, waiting hall, baggage wrapping and lost baggage. Level 2: security, business lounge and police. From 25.10.2026 to 27.03.2027 the terminal is open Mon–Sat 06:00–21:00, Sun 06:00–12:00.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge in the departure hall on Level 2, up to 49 seats. Departure or arrival 7,450 ₽, child 2–12 years 3,725 ₽, under 2 free. Those seeing off and meeting passengers 3,240 ₽. Phones: +7 (3919) 31-54-22, 31-53-89.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: The airport rest house (profilaktoriy) on the station forecourt. 30 rooms with 55 beds, open round the clock. Passengers and other citizens are accommodated on presentation of a passport; payment is for whole days, 100% prepayment. Phone +7 (3919) 31-53-70.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 2 of the terminal. Free for women with children under 5 and women in the second half of pregnancy. If a flight is delayed, children under 7 are accommodated free of charge at the airline's expense. There is a bedroom, a playroom and an area for preparing and eating food.
